steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Greek drama developed from religious festivals honouring Dionysus; tragedies and comedies were performed at the City Dionysia festival in Athens | Key Fact: Three great tragedians: Aeschylus (introduced second actor), Sophocles (introduced third actor, painted scenery), Euripides (questioned traditional values) | Key Fact: Aristophanes wrote Old Comedy that satirised contemporary politicians and issues (e.g. The Wasps, The Clouds) | Key Fact: Theatre was a civic institution: the state funded productions, citizens attended as a duty, and wealthy choregoi (producers) sponsored choruses as a liturgy

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from greek theatre &amp; the arts, and one past-paper question.
